findings: The successor experiment uses only the public Harness boundary and regenerates all nineteen artifacts byte-for-byte with exact checkpoint replay and natural quiescence.

Causal-return-reference, opportunity-reference, and choice-to-motion survived; twelve predicted transitions were scientifically falsified and four dependent compositions were correctly classified inconclusive.
Signed local choice produces nonzero reflected physical motion, so motor sign integration is not the first frozen one-joint divergence.

The strongest localized failures are entrenched historical strength, unbounded idle return eligibility, dormant-surface global scanning, failure to distinguish distant alternatives from necessary local coalitions, and first-arrival-only surface association.
The core public-boundary suite passed 18 tests with two unchanged adversarial tests ignored; the representative warm successor regression completed in 1.43 seconds, strictly under 10 seconds.
residual_uncertainty: The falsified current mechanisms do not prove that the five proposed successor mechanism families are uniquely necessary.
Binocular, hand, eye-hand, vocal-auditory, and full-body outcomes remain bounded to synthetic physical fixtures and later compositions were not interpreted after prerequisite failure.
No learner physics, protocol authority, Academy claim, or ARC capability was adopted; this remains discovery evidence over the exact dirty tree in the candidate receipt.
